verdict.rationale: Google documents 'Gemini in BigQuery' features (conversational analytics, data canvas) that let users converse in natural language to find/join/query data, generate or suggest SQL/Python code, and explain existing SQL queries — directly matching the story of an in-product AI assistant working with schemas from natural language (bigquery-docs-5, bigquery-docs-39, bigquery-docs-66, bigquery-docs-71, bigquery-docs-72). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of this specific assistant feature (community evidence covers pricing/performance, not the AI assistant), and explicit documentation of 'fixing' broken SQL rather than just generating/suggesting/explaining.
